Commentary.Commentary: Sri Lanka started off well in the Powerplay, with Malinga and Rajitha reducing the hosts to 33/4. But, they let their foot off the gas at the halfway mark and ended up conceding 124 runs in the last 10 overs. Sandakan, Thisara Perera and Kasun Rajitha who all started so well ended up with conceding more than 10 runs per over. Sri Lanka will have to bat well if they are to chase this one. They will look for a good start, whereas New Zealand will look for early breakthroughs. Join us on the other side of the break.

What a fightback by the Kiwis. Sri Lanka will be very disappointed that they are chasing 180. They were right on top at the halfway mark of the innings. New Zealand were 55/5 with half the side back in the hut. It looked like they would struggle to get anywhere close to 140 but Ross Taylor's slow but steady 33, Doug Bracewell's 26-ball 44 and debutant Scott Kuggeleijn's quickfire 35 helped New Zealand post 179 on the board.

SIX! Second six of the over. Full on middle, Kuggeleijn lofts it over wide long on for a biggie. Big over for New Zealand. 17 runs off it. New Zealand end with 179/7. Sri Lanka need 180 to win this match.
Full on off, Southee drives it towards mid off for a single.
SIX! Good batting from New Zealand. Length delivery on off, Southee lofts it over long off for a biggie. Sri Lanka are leaking runs here.
Short outside off, Southee cuts it through point. The batsmen pick up a couple.
Full on off, Kuggeleijn drives it towards mid off for a single.
Outside off, Southee looks to pull but misses it. The keeper fires a direct hit at the strikers end but the batsman was well in. The batsmen get a single. Umpire gives it as a bye.
Another slower ball on middle, worked away to deep fine leg for a single. Good over from the SL skipper. Ends with figures of 4-0-24-2.

Length ball on middle, flicked away to deep square leg for a couple. That's brilliant running on this small ground. Dickwella collects and takes the bails off but the square leg umpire says the batsman is well in.

How did that one miss the stumps! A perfectly executed slower one once more, Scott is early into his shot and misses the ball. The ball goes inches away from leg stump and Dickwella behind fails to collect cleanly. The batsmen run a bye.
Another slower one outside off, this time it is flicked away to fine leg for a single.
Foxed! Such a perfect slower ball on length and above middle stump. Southee is too early into his pull and beaten.
Yorker length ball on middle, taken on the full and flicked away to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Lasith Malinga comes back to bowl now.
Full on middle, Kuggeleijn drives it towards mid on for a single. Big over for New Zealand. 18 runs off it.
SIX! 150 up for New Zealand. Consecutive sixes from Scott Kuggeleijn. Short of a length delivery, Kuggeleijn pulls it over backward square leg for a biggie. Sri Lanka losing their way here.
SIX! Good shot from Scott Kuggeleijn. Length delivery on middle, Scott lofts it over mid-wicket for a biggie.
Tim Southee out next.

OUT! Bracewell departs! Much needed wicket for Sri Lanka. Slower delivery outside off, Bracewell looks to go over long off but does not get enough on it. Dhananjaya de Silva runs from his right and takes a good catch at long off. New Zealand have lost their seventh wicket.
Full on off, Kuggeleijn drives it towards covers for a single.
FOUR! Poor delivery from Rajitha. Full toss outside leg, Kuggeleijn flicks it towards fine leg for a boundary.

FOUR! Length ball once more and Bracewell takes full toll! Pulls this away through square leg and finds the fence once more. 23 off the over! Really expensive! Thisara Perera ends with 1-42 off his quota of overs.
SIX! Bracewell is turning on the heat here. Short of a length on middle and leg, Doug comes inside the line and pulls it over deep fine leg for another maximum, the third off this over.
Length ball outside off this time, Doug misses his slash and the ball flies through to the keeper.
SIX! Two in two! Length ball outside off, Bracewell clears his front leg and smashes it over wide long on. The ball goes way into the fence.
Kasun Rajitha back on to bowl.
SIX! That's smashed back over the bowler's head and right into the sightscreen! Full toss and Bracewell lifts it right back down the ground. Goes all the way for a biggie!
Length ball on middle, Scott tries to pull this one away but the ball climbs on him and gets hit on the shoulder. Leg bye taken towards point.
Floated on off, Bracewell drives it towards covers for a single. 13 runs off the over. Big over for New Zealand.
SIX! Bracewell is looking good here. Tossed up on middle, Doug Bracewell comes down the track and lofts it over long on for a biggie.
Floated on middle, Scott comes down the track and plays it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Short delivery, Bracewell pulls it towards mid-wicket for a run.
WIDE! Wide outside off, Bracewell lets it go.
WIDE! Bowls down the leg side, Bracewell looks to go for the slog sweep but misses it.
Tossed up on middle, Bracewell sweeps it to short fine leg.
Outside off, Kuggeleijn plays it towards covers for a single.
WIDE! Wide outside off, Kuggeleijn offers no shot.
Shorter length ball outside off, Kuggeleijn runs it to third man for a single as he dabs it down. Off the mark! First runs for him in his career.
Debutant Scott Kuggeleijn to bat next.

OUT! A huge wicket at a crucial point in the game! Slower ball, wide outside off and Taylor tries to pull it away over mid-wicket. Gets a thin feather as the ball crosses him and Dickwella makes no mistake behind. The umpire didn't seem to have heard it but Ross Taylor walks off as he knows he had nicked that one. Great sportsman spirit and there is no need for a review. Sri Lanka could not have chosen a better time for the wicket. Taylor could have hurt them but now, NZ will have a new batsman out in the middle with 5 overs to go.
Yorker length outside off, taken on the full and hit to long off on the bounce. Another single taken.
Length ball outside off, Taylor plays it away to third man with an angled bat. Single taken.

FOUR! Incredible shot! Pre-meditated. Fuller length ball, Taylor comes ahead and ramps it over the short fine leg fielder and the ball runs away for a boundary. Great batting from Ross. The hundred comes up for the hosts.
Length ball on off, pulled away to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Thisara Perera is back into the attack now.
Floated on middle, Bracewell comes down the track and hits it towards covers for a single. 10 runs off the over. Good over for New Zealand.
WIDE! Outside off, Bracewell lets it go.
WIDE! Bowls down the leg side, Bracewell looks to sweep but misses it.
Flighted delivery outside off, Bracewell comes down the track and misses it. The keeper missed a stumping chance.
Floated on off, Bracewell comes down the track and drives it to covers.
Flighted delivery on middle, Taylor nudges it towards the leg side for a run.
Tossed up on middle, Taylor looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
SIX! What a way to start this over. Tossed up on leg, Taylor lofts it over wide long on for a biggie.

Length ball outside off, Taylor comes ahead and pushes this towards mid off. Goes for a quick single and mid off misfields as the run is completed really easily. 17 runs off this over! Maybe this is the push that NZ needed. Kumara ends with figures of 4-0-24-0.
Single as DB drives this length one through the covers.

SIX! The free hit has been pulled away for six over the deep fine leg fence. Short length aimed at the body, Bracewell swivels and hoicks it over the fence at fine leg. This is turning out to be an expensive over. Bracewell's second maximum, maybe he is warming up here!

No ball! A no ball has been called for a second bouncer in the over. The bowler doesn't seem too impressed and replays show that it was a tough call. Free Hit to follow though! The field can't change either.
On the hips off a length, worked to deep square leg. The batsmen come back for two, good running!
Another short one to follow, Doug tries to smash it over mid-wicket by pulling it off the back foot but fails to connect.

FIVE WIDES! That's flown off! On a short length and this one has absolutely taken off. Bounces over the head of the batsman as Bracewell tries to upper cut it. It is too high for the keeper as well and the ball runs to the fence in no time.
Pacy ball on length and coming in after landing on off and middle. Taylor is beaten by the pace and gets hit on the thigh pad. Runs through for a leg bye as the ball rolls towards point.

SIX! New Zealand get a boundary after a long time. Flighted delivery on middle, Bracewell comes down the track and lofts it over long off for a biggie. The hosts need more of these. 11 runs of the over and a very expensive over for Sri Lanka and a much needed one for New Zealand. The hosts would like to have more such overs.
Full on middle, Taylor drives it towards mid on for a single.

Floated on off, Bracewell drives it straight back towards the bowler. The batsmen go for a risky single and get it easily in the end. Sandakan got confused where the ball had gone. Non-striker could have been run out if the bowler would have collected it cleanly.
Flighted delivery on off, Taylor comes down the track and plays it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Floated on middle, Bracewell comes down the track and hits it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Tossed up on off, Taylor rocks back and cuts it to third man for a single.
Yes, he can. Good ball on length once more on the leg stump line. Doug just pats it back down. No run. Only 2 runs off this over, brilliant in T20s. Kumara's figures read 3-0-8-0 so far!
Length ball on top of middle, Doug just pats it back to the bowler. Only 2 runs so far, can Lahiru end this well?
Bouncer! Well-aimed at the batsman's head. Bracewell ducks under it and lets it go.
Another one that is slightly down the leg side, Taylor drops it on the leg side once more and gets a single.
Quick one, 142.4 kph again on the hips. Doug plays it away on the leg side with soft hands and gets off the mark with a quick single.
Length ball on top of middle, Bracewell defends it back to the bowler from the crease.
Doug Bracewell walks into the middle next.

OUT! Santner departs! Timely breakthrough for Sri Lanka. Flighted delivery on middle, Santner dances down the track and looks to go over long off but does not get enough on it. There is some confusion between the two fielders in the deep but Thisara Perera at long off calls and takes a comfortable catch in the end. Would have been a nasty collision if not for the loud call from TP. At the end of 10 overs, NZ have 55 runs and half their side is back in the hut. Run Rate is 5.50. Sri Lanka well on top here.
Flighted delivery on middle, Santner gets an inside edge and it goes towards fine leg. The batsmen pick up a couple.
Short delivery, Taylor pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up on off, Taylor looks to drive but gets hit on the pad.
FOUR! Googly outside off, Taylor hits it straight past the bowler over mid off for a boundary. No chance of stopping that one, the ball went too straight and fast for any fielder to come around.
Tossed up on off, Santner hits it through mid-wicket for a single.
Lakshan Sandakan to roll his arm over.

Pacy ball on length and middle stump line, Taylor makes room and tries to slash it over the off side but misses the ball completely as he is beaten by pace. Brilliant over from Kumara, just three singles off it in the end!
Shorter length on middle, this time Mitchell stands tall and pulls it away hard to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Short of a lenght ball on top of middle and leg, Santner comes inside the line and tries to play it fine on the leg side but misses. Looks for a wide to be signalled but it's not.
Length ball on middle and Taylor tries to make room but the bowler followed him and cramped him for room. He can just nudge it on the leg side for a run.
Another length outside off, Taylor tries to pull but the ball is too quick and he gets hit high on the bat. 146.8 kph that one! The ball goes to mid-wicket. No run.
Fuller length, pacy 141.6 kph on off. Santner flicks it away to deep square leg for a single.
Length delivery on middle, the left-hander flicks it towards square leg for a single. 8 runs off the over. Good over for New Zealand.

FOUR! Good shot from Santner. Length delivery on leg, Santner flicks it over mid-wicket for a boundary. A welcome back boundary and a much needed one for the hosts. The onus is on these two to guide New Zealand to a defendable total.
Length delivery on off, Santner keeps it out.
Short of a length delivery, Taylor pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Full on leg, Santner drives it through mid on for a single.
Short of a length ball on off, Taylor pulls this away to deep square leg for a single.
Length delivery on middle, Taylor pushes it to mid on for a single.
Full on off, Santner drives it to mid off for a run.
Full toss on middle, Taylor drives it towards mid on for a single.
BEATEN! Outside off, Taylor looks again to cut but misses it and is beaten by pace.
Short outside off, Taylor looks to cut but misses it.
Full on off, Taylor drives it straight to mid off.
Lahiru Kumara to bowl now.
Length delivery on middle, Ross flicks it away on the leg side for a single. And that's the end of the Powerplay and a great one for the visitors. New Zealand are 33-4 after the end of the 6 overs.

Great effort! Length delivery on off, Ross tries to square cut it but gets an edge. The ball goes towards Kusal Perera at short third man but falls just short of him who was diving to his front. And fair play to him he straightaway said that he got it on a bounce. If that would have carried New Zealand would have been in a bigger trouble.
Fuller length delivery by Thisara and it finds the leading edge of Taylor's bat luckily for him, he played that with soft hand.
Length delivery on middle, Santner guides it towards the third man region and takes a quick single.
Perera misses his line completely and bowls down the leg side. Mitchell tries to flick but misses it and the umpire signals it as wide.
Fuller delivery on off, Santner defends it off his front foot.
Starts off with a slower delivery on length, Taylor flicks it away on the leg side for a single.
Thisara Perera into the attack now.
Full on off, the left-hander drives it to mid off. Just one run off the over.
Full on off, Santner drives it straight back towards the bowler.
Bowls a yorker on middle, Santner does well to dig it out but gets an inside edge onto the pads. Good bowling from Malinga.
Length delivery on middle, Taylor flicks it towards the leg side for a run.
Good length delivery on off, Taylor taps it to point.
Good length delivery on off, Taylor defends off the back foot.

Slightly outside off this time, Ross pats it down with soft hands behind the wicket and runs through for a quick single. 6 runs off the over but the important fact is another wicket. Sri Lankans well on top here.
Another good delivery on middle, Taylor defends it watchfully back down the ground.

Almost had two in two! A great delivery on a length and seaming away after landing. Taylor closes the face of his bat too early and the ball flies in the air towards point off the leading edge. Dhananjaya comes ahead and dives to take that catch but the ball lands just short! Brilliant from Rajitha and SL though.
Mitchell Santner walks in at number 6, replacing Munro.

OUT! Munro departs after getting a start here. And New Zealand are in big, big trouble. Rajitha pulls back the length on this one and Munro tries to pull it away but is early on his shot. The ball flies high in the air and once again, Sandakan takes an easy catch coming in from covers. Commentators' curse for Munro, he was looking very good out in the middle. Second wicket for the young Rajitha and he has got rid off the big fish.
FOUR! Munro looking in a very good touch here. Length delivery on off, Munro opens the face off the bat and beautifully finds the gap to find the fence. He looks like he isn going to score big today.
Fuller on middle, Taylor flicks it away towards square leg for a single.
Length delivery on middle, Taylor flicks it to mid-wicket for a run. Ross Taylor is off the mark.
Ross Taylor in at number 5, a lot earlier than he would have liked.

OUT! BOWLED! Nicholls departs! New Zealand are three down in no time. Length delivery on off, Henry drives away from his body but the ball swings in late. He gets an inside edge and the ball goes on to crash into his leg stump. New Zealand have lost three wickets inside three overs and Sri Lanka are chipping away at the hosts' batting line-up. The Kiwis are in big trouble.
IN THE AIR BUT SAFE! Length delivery outside off, Nicholls looks to drive but it goes through point. He was foxed by the slower one there but luckily went in the gap. The batsmen pick up a couple.
Length delivery on middle, Munro nudges it towards the leg side for a run.

FOUR! Poor delivery from Malinga. Bowls full on pads, Munro flicks it towards deep backward square leg for a boundary. Once it beat the man at 45 in the circle, there was no chance of stopping that, races across the turf to the fence.
Full toss on middle, Nicholls drives it towards mid on for a single. If Thisara Perera would have collected that properly and hit the stumps with a throw, there could have been a chance of a run out.

A bit fuller on this occasion, Nicholls drives it to mid off and takes a quick single, the fielder has a go at the non-striker end but misses. If he would have hit it would have been close call. A very good start here for Rajitha, just 4 runs and a wicket of that over.
Length delivery on middle, Nicholls gets right behind it and defends it.
Wide! Rajitha misses his line and bowls it far away on the off, Henry tries to have a go at at but misses. The umpire signals it as wide.
Fuller delivery on off, Nicholls starts off with a front foot defence.
Henry Nicholls walks to the crease at number 4.

OUT! Sri Lanka strike another one and Tim Seifert is back in the pavilion. Rajitha bowls a length delivery on off, Seifert tries to flick it away on the leg side but he is way too early in his shot. The ball angles away from him after pitching which completely deceives Seifert. The ball goes off his leading edge and Sandakan takes an easy catch at cover.
Fuller delivery outside off, Seifert watchful defends it.
Starts off with a fuller delivery on middle, Seifert flicks it away to the mid-wicket region for a couple.
Kasun Rajitha will bowl from the other end.
Outside off, it rises off the deck, Munro looks to drive but misses it. The keeper collects it over his head. 9 runs off the over but SL would not mind as they picked up an important wicket.

SIX! Amazing shot from Colin Munro. Slower delivery on off, Munro lofts it over long on for a biggie. There are small boundaries on this ground. If it would have been a bigger boundary, he would have been caught at long on.
WIDE! Bowls this well down the leg side, Munro lets it go.
Tim Seifert is the next batsman in.

OUT! Martin Guptill departs! Big wicket for Sri Lanka. Malinga with the early strike yet again. Extra bounce on this one. Length delivery on middle, Guptill looks to pull but gets a top edge on this one. Kusal Mendis at mid-wicket goes a little behind and takes a good catch at mid on. New Zealand lose their first wicket. Just the start Sri Lanka would have wanted though.
Full on off, Munro drives it towards covers where the fielder makes a good stop but still the batsman get a run.
Length delivery on off, Guptill nudges it towards the leg side for a single.
Starts off with a good length delivery on off, Guptill defends off the front foot.

The players and the umpires are out in the middle for the start of this one-off T20I. Martin Guptill and Colin Munro will open the innings for New Zealand. Sri Lanka skipper Lasith Malinga will bowl the first over.

Pitch Report - There is pace and bounce for the bowlers, so the batsmen will have to adjust. Hard soil has been put into the surface, hence it's a good ground to play cricket on. It's being said that if this was an ODI, then batting first would have been the way to go, but in a T20I bowling first is the right choice. The ball will come on to the bat as well despite it being bowler friendly, so it should make for an even contest.

New Zealand skipper, Tim Southee, says Jimmy Neesham and Seth Rance miss out. On Scott Kuggeleijn's debut, Southee is excited and mentions that he has some domestic pedigree to back it up. Continues saying that Doug Bracewell is back and it's good to have him in the side after his long injury. On their winning streak, he adds that it's been a great start this summer and wants to finish on a high. Ends by saying that Sri Lanka are a dangerous side as they showed in the ODIs and they are wary of that threat.

Sri Lanka skipper, Lasith Malinga, says it is a small ground but if the bowlers do well then the batsmen can benefit from that. Informs that there are plenty of changes made, as they want to see how the players can handle the pressure with the upcoming World Cup in mind. States that this type of game you have to prepare differently and they will try to do their best.
TOSS - Sri Lanka win the toss and elect to bowl first!

Hello and welcome to the one-off T20I between New Zealand and Sri Lanka at Eden Park, Auckland. The hosts have won the Test and ODI series and would like to end with a win in this one-off T20I. There are some injuries to some of their players, so expect changes. The likes of Mitchell Santner and Doug Bracewell should feature in the XI after long injury lay-offs. On the other hand, the visitors have nothing to lose and would like to do better in the T20I game at least. They need to improve their bowling and try to be consistent with their batting also. Sri Lanka would want their openers to fire again and set a platform for other batsmen. Plenty of changes expected in this camp too. What is in store for us? We'll find out soon. Stay tuned, as the toss and pitch report are about to come up.
